name: io.github.deciduus/calendar-mcp
description: MCP server for Google Calendar: list calendars, find, create, update, move and delete events, check attendee status, query free/busy, and analyse busyness.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID for a Google Cloud project with the Google Calendar API enabled.

environmentVariables.name: TOKEN_FILE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the saved OAuth token file written by 'calendar-mcp auth'.
